title: LEGO Star Trek Enterprise Bridge (REVIEW)
description:
To celebrate the 60th anniversary of Star Trek, LEGO released the U.S.S. Enterprise NCC-1701 Bridge set, with the core selection of characters of the original series. This thing is filled with detail, easter eggs and pretty much everything trekkies could ask for. But at what cost?
Come find out in my detailed LEGO set review.
